display.description: CI, build VMs, rolls, task gates and task analytics from factoryd's OTel metrics. Applied by the signoz-dashboard CronJob from the infra repository; edits in the UI are overwritten.
display.name: factory pipeline
Build VM lifetime and ready time
CI queue time by runner label (p95)
Main CI run duration per day
Roll-to-live: push to apply to ready

display.description: factory.alert.count sampled at the end of each day: every alerts row ever, by kind (gate_bound, supervisor_trip, escalation, info_request, alert) and verdict (real, noise, open until one is set); the largest of the factoryd pods' reports, since each reports the whole table
display.name: Alerts per kind and verdict (total at each day's end)

display.description: factory.task.outcome: tasks finished that day by final state (done, failed, closed), counted at Finish; reverted: factory.task.reverted, the merged agent tasks the daily revert pass marked that day (a revert of their pull request or their alert filed again, within 14 days), a share of earlier done tasks drawn on the same stack because SigNoz draws no line on a bar panel. Each factoryd pod counts its own tasks, so the pods are summed.
display.name: Tasks per outcome per day, and reverts

display.description: factory.task.cost of the tasks that finished with their pull request merged, by the alias of the task's last session (none: a roll, which runs no session), p50 and p95 per day from the histogram buckets 0.01 to 10 EUR; the spend booked by Finish, not LiteLLM's later settlement.
display.name: Cost per merged pull request per alias (EUR)

display.description: factory.review.verdict: every model review answer by its round on the task and its verdict (approve, concerns, none for a refused, failed or invalid answer), summed over the factoryd pods.
display.name: Model review verdicts per round per day

display.description: factory.human.intervention: approve, request_changes and reject on a console merge card, alert_verdict_click, escalation_answer and poster_answer (new comments answering a waiting task, typed in the console or in Forgejo), extra_time (an answer that raised the agent time), summed over the factoryd pods.
display.name: Human interventions per kind per day
